pages.text: A road-switcher on two bogies: 52 km/h, and it pulls harder than the steam engines.

It runs on $(thing)diesel$(): BuildCraft Reborn's $(l)Dense Fuel$() or $(l)Mixed Heavy Fuels$(), or other mods' diesel. Its tank holds 16 buckets of Dense Fuel: a bucket lasts about five minutes at full throttle, nearly an hour idling.$(br2)Fill it with buckets or pipes, or at a $(l:freight/wagon_loader)wagon loader$(/l) with a tank of diesel beside it.
It won't take coal, and steam engines won't take diesel. Its engine rumbles, rising with the throttle, its exhaust smokes harder the harder it works, and it sounds a two-tone horn.
